violent.label: Violent / Tense
modifiers: two groups clashing, shoves and raised fists
figures in a tense standoff, weapons half-drawn
figures shouting openly, scrambling apart

charming.label: Charming / Idyllic
modifiers: small groups chatting, shoulders relaxed
some subjects with heads tipped back laughing, hands resting on each other's shoulders
figures leaning back, unhurried gestures, quiet smiles

satirical.label: Satirical / Comedic
modifiers: subjects striking exaggerated poses, wide grins, arms flung out
one figure hamming it up, arms spread, a deep theatrical bow
subjects with exaggerated grimaces, raised eyebrows, oversized gestures

eerie.label: Eerie / Uncanny
modifiers: figures frozen mid-step, heads turned all the same way
subjects too still, gazes fixed on something out of view
subjects with lips pressed shut, eyes tracking movement

mundane.label: Mundane / Domestic
modifiers: subjects with heads down over everyday tasks, eyes on their work
figures going about separate tasks, barely glancing at each other
subjects mid-stride, hands in pockets, exchanging small talk

triumphant.label: Triumphant / Victorious
modifiers: some subjects with fists pumped, chins lifted
some subjects with hands raised overhead, backs straight, wide grins
subjects with shoulders dropping, heads tipped back, wide smiles

melancholy.label: Melancholy / Wistful
modifiers: seated figures, elbows on knees, eyes down
one figure reluctant to leave, glancing back over their shoulder
subjects with downcast eyes, slack shoulders, slow small movements

solemn.label: Solemn / Ceremonial
modifiers: figures standing in neat rows, hands folded, eyes down
figures moving with measured deliberation, heads bowed
figures with slow deliberate gestures, straight backs, silence

romantic.label: Romantic / Tender
modifiers: two figures standing close, foreheads nearly touching
two figures leaning into each other, faces turned toward one another
two figures sharing a long gaze, soft smiles

restless.label: Restless / Anxious
modifiers: figures shifting weight foot to foot, hands rubbing together
some subjects appear suspicious, hands fidgeting, eyes darting sideways
some subjects with hands balled into fists, tight shoulders, short glances
